top_paper.title: Agentic Game Development as a Verifiable Trajectory Data Engine for Scaling World Models
top_paper.summary: Game engines provide executable verification and long-horizon trajectories for reinforcement learning post-training of spatial world models, motivating a human-engine verification paradigm.

papers.title: Luce: Relightable Gaussians for 3D Asset Generation
papers.summary: Luce unifies geometry and PBR materials in a voxelized Gaussian cloud, using a variational autoencoder and rectified-flow transformer to generate relightable 3D assets from single images.

papers.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes
papers.summary: CritICL improves LLM reasoning at inference time by using structured failure patterns from weaker models as critique-based guidance, reducing generation and token costs.

papers.title: TacForcing: Streaming Action Generation with Execution-Time Tactile Feedback
papers.summary: TacForcing is a streaming action-generation framework that integrates real-time tactile feedback during execution via a streaming action expert and execution-aware tactile attention, improving contact-rich manipulation.

papers.title: What Does an Evaluation License? A Commit-Bound Census of Claim-Relative Inference in Inspect Evals
papers.summary: Evaluation artifacts specify a forward computation: a task, scorer, and reported metric. They do not necessarily license the claim attached to that metric because the historical evidence and alternative semantics needed to replay it may be unbound. We formalize this missing claim-replay layer through a frozen substrate D, a grounded family F, a claim query q, and the resulting identified set. We then census all 124 mechanically eligible Inspect Evals units at a pinned commit. papers.title: EditaLive! Unified Character Video Editing for Live Streaming
papers.summary: EditaLive enables real-time human-centric live-stream video editing by adapting an image animation model to causal streaming generation with distilled two-step sampling and sparse attention.

papers.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary: PILOT enables live self-improvement by allowing a supervisor to steer active workers and distilling execution experience into reusable skills, improving accuracy and efficiency.

papers.title: Agentic Game Development as a Verifiable Trajectory Data Engine for Scaling World Models
papers.summary: Game engines provide executable verification and long-horizon trajectories for reinforcement learning post-training of spatial world models, motivating a human-engine verification paradigm.

papers.title: Procedura: Agentic 3D Modeling with Procedural Control
papers.summary: Procedura is a 3D modeling agent that generates editable, part-structured procedural assemblies with sharp geometry and validated articulation from text prompts.

papers.title: Thinking on Shots: Consistent Multi-Shot Video Editing with Agentic Reasoning
papers.summary: An agentic framework combining LLMs and VLMs enables consistent, multi-instruction editing of long multi-shot videos while preserving spatiotemporal structure.

papers.title: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games
papers.summary: GameWAM is a unified world-action model for native video-game control that jointly predicts future visuals and executable keyboard-mouse actions using block-causal flow matching, mode-specific distributions, and block-cycle replanning.

papers.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
papers.summary: Test-Time Policy Optimization enables label-free test-time training for mathematical reasoning by asymmetrically distilling agreeing rollouts and penalizing disagreeing ones, matching supervised performance.

papers.title: Aphanta: Diagnosing Task-Aligned Image-Edited Intermediates for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.summary: Aphanta evaluates when image-editing intermediates improve multimodal reasoning by testing direct, editor-generated, and idealized visual states across tasks.

papers.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.summary: CaSKG calibrates procedural skill relations via counterfactual-causal graph construction to improve compact, executable retrieval for LLM agents.

papers.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report
papers.summary: Harness-Aware Training enables compact models to adapt to evolving digital-avatar harness configurations with low latency and high accuracy.

papers.title: CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension
papers.summary: CaRGo-T improves multimodal humor understanding by modeling causal relationships as graph-based reasoning structures interpreted by vision-language models.

papers.title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
papers.summary: The study formalizes probabilistic alignment for world models, introduces PAWBench and PAWEval to evaluate video generators as stochastic samplers, and finds current models fail to match reference behavior distributions.

papers.title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City
papers.summary: UrbanGround evaluates whether multimodal language model agents can sustain reliable navigation and spatial reasoning in a realistic 3D city replica, revealing that local perceptual skills fail to compose into extended goal-directed behavior.

papers.title: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
papers.summary: Zero-WAM enables robotic manipulation of unseen tasks by conditioning a causal video-action model on in-context human video guidance, supported by an automatically generated dataset and a future-chunk prediction objective.

papers.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
papers.summary: WikiSkill co-evolves reusable agent skills with a persistent knowledge base to systematically accumulate experience and improve performance across models.

papers.title: Self-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models without Teacher
papers.summary: Self-OPD eliminates task-specific teachers in flow matching by using self-explored stochastic branches and normalized advantages to optimize the velocity field for multi-objective alignment.

papers.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
papers.summary: Evolution strategies improve reasoning diversity and Pass@K over GRPO through sparse functional updates and population diversity, supporting a hybrid training approach.

papers.title: Magpie: Real-Time World Renderer for Interactive Games
papers.summary: Magpie is a real-time generative rendering system that separates gameplay logic from visual generation to preserve interactive designability while reducing asset requirements for game prototypes.

papers.title: What Makes Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Agentic data generation is framed as constrained distribution design over factorized experience tuples, emphasizing execution-grounded accuracy, learner-relative complexity, and diversity rather than scale alone.

papers.title: GUI-Primitives: Diagnosing Spatial Reasoning Failures in Vision-Language GUI Grounding
papers.summary: A benchmark of contrastive GUI instructions reveals that vision-language models mostly fail to localize interface elements rather than misunderstand spatial relations, though marking candidates substantially improves selection.

papers.title: Skill Issue: Are Skills Language-Invariant in LLMs?
papers.summary: Multilingual self-play reveals that large language models exhibit significant cross-lingual skill inconsistencies in reasoning and strategy, partly recoverable by altering intermediate reasoning language.

papers.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
papers.summary: Prefix Sliding reduces memory costs during long reasoning by discarding unimportant intermediate tokens, enabling efficient test-time scaling without retraining.

papers.title: Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling
papers.summary: BaguanHR improves high-resolution weather forecasting by using variable-wise super-resolution to synthesize training data, overcoming the limits of coarse-resolution model transfer and demonstrating strong scaling benefits.

papers.title: LibriBrain100: One Hundred Hours of Broad and Deep MEG Data for Neural Speech Decoding at Scale
papers.summary: LibriBrain100 is a large-scale MEG speech dataset that demonstrates improved decoding through extensive within-subject recordings and multi-subject supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained models.

papers.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?
papers.summary: The study introduces a benchmark for evaluating autonomous software migration by coding agents, finding that current models rarely complete migrations correctly.

papers.title: A Modular Agent for Reliable and Auditable Spatial Relation Verification in CT Scans
papers.summary: A modular medical imaging agent decomposes spatial relation verification into parsing, anatomical localization, and geometric rules to outperform end-to-end vision-language models on CT spatial reasoning.
